general.descriptionTextModule: Integrate your Shopware store with Dropday.io for automated order fulfillment

dashboard.title: Dropday Integration
dashboard.welcomeText: Dropday helps you automate your order fulfillment by connecting your Shopware store with your suppliers. Orders are automatically sent to Dropday when they reach the configured status, streamlining your dropshipping workflow.
dashboard.connectionErrorMessage: Could not connect to Dropday API. Please check your API credentials.

order.syncSuccessMessage: The order has been successfully sent to Dropday.
order.syncErrorMessage: Failed to send order to Dropday. Please check the logs for details.
